headline: The STI slipped 0.4-0.5% on Monday to about 4,952 but held above 4,900. Overnight, Wall Street rebounded strongly (S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq +6.5%) as Nvidia jumped about 30% on Jensen Huang's return as CEO, so a firmer open is likely. Oil fell again. Gains may be short covering.
